statement: The overall design boundary and three key areas use repository provisional geometry and are not official redlines.
risk: Area, frontage, parcel, access and project quantities may change after official CAD/GIS replacement.
mitigation: Research scope is separated into constraints.geojson; all precision-sensitive values are tagged provisional or low confidence and must be recalculated.

statement: Regulatory FAR, height, land-use, municipal capacity, ownership, accessibility and property constraints are not publicly available in the checked package.
risk: Project lists, building actions, public-space claims and service scenarios require later calibration to statutory planning and human review.
mitigation: Use conceptual reference schemes, retain-renovate logic, public-benefit gates, human review, offline service equivalents and explicit exit conditions.

statement: The proposal is an open-source concept submission and not a qualification-stage legal tender document.
risk: Formal tender eligibility and seal requirements are outside agent scope.
mitigation: Provide editable structured files, an English counterpart, rights declaration, scenario governance notes and a copyright statement for team review.

statement: The spatial layers represent design intent and public-space relationships, not an existing-condition survey.
risk: The package cannot certify existing buildings, green-space baselines, accessibility, traffic safety or carbon performance.
mitigation: Use geometry only for conceptual comparison and require field survey, official data and professional calculations before implementation.
